title: The Missing Mittens
scene: At 3:30 PM, every guest's left mitten vanished from the lodge drying rack. A snowstorm kept the front door shut from 3:00 to 3:40.

suspects.name: Rolf Hayes
suspects.testimony: I was out on the slope teaching a lesson from 3:10 to 3:40. I only came in afterward.
suspects.contradiction: The door lock log shows no exits, and the rack camera caught his sleeve at 3:22.

suspects.name: Pia Moreau
suspects.testimony: I was stirring chili in the kitchen all afternoon. I stepped out for nothing.
suspects.alibiProof: The stove timer was reset by her badge at 3:12 and again at 3:28.

suspects.name: Wanda Pell
suspects.testimony: I was soaking in the hot tub room from 3:00 to 3:40. I only left to fetch a towel.
suspects.alibiProof: Her towel slip reads 3:02 in and 3:38 out, signed at the spa desk.

suspects.name: Theo Marsh
suspects.testimony: I was at the front desk answering phones all afternoon. I never touched the drying rack.
suspects.alibiProof: The desk phone log shows five calls under his login between 3:05 and 3:35.
